resources.string: The battery charges up to %1$d%%, then the phone runs from the charger. Charging resumes at %2$d%%.

The battery stops charging at its current level (below 70% it charges to 70% first) and the phone runs from the charger, for gaming or recording while plugged in. If the phone needs more power than the charger gives, the battery tops up again once it is 3% lower.
As fast as the charger and the phone temperature allow
Up to %1$d W into the battery
Could not write the fast charging limit

Bypass turns itself off after a reboot. It uses Settings > Battery > Charging control (limit mode); your previous charging control settings come back when it is turned off.\n\nThe power limit stays on after a reboot. It caps the power going into the battery, so the charger itself draws a little more. Overheating protection can still slow charging down further.
